preconditions.description: The length of the input string s must be between 1 and 10 inclusive.
All characters in the input string s must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'NA' or a string of length one greater than the input string s.
The output string must be a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: any(c in stdout for c in s)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain at least one character from the input string s.
